Question 17
?

The line segment XY― is a diameter of a circle. Given that X and Y have coordinates (2,4) and (2,0), respectively, what is the equation of the circle?

a
(x−2)2+(y−2)2=4
b
(x−2)2+(y+2)2=4
c
(x+2)2+(y+2)2=4
d
(x−2)2+(y−2)2=16
e
(x+2)2+(y+2)2=16
